entries.label: solar.latitude_cooling_factor
entries.description: Poles are this fraction cooler than the equator (0.3 = 30% cooler). Raise if the poles feel too warm; lower if the equator/pole difference is too extreme.

entries.label: solar.cloud_albedo
entries.description: Clouds reduce solar heating by this fraction (0.4 = 40% reduction). Raise if cloudy regions stay too warm.

entries.label: solar.water_heat_capacity
entries.description: How fast oceans change temperature (lower = slower). Lower it if ocean temperatures change too slowly across seasons.

entries.label: solar.land_heat_capacity
entries.description: How fast land changes temperature (higher = faster). Raise it if inland regions lack a seasonal swing.

entries.label: solar.cloud_decay
entries.description: Share of cloud cover lost each week (Feature 2 pass 1); an A4 extension, not in the GDD section 14 table.

entries.label: pressure.pressure_sensitivity
entries.description: How strongly temperature deviation drives pressure (higher = stronger storms). Lower it if pressure fluctuates wildly and wind turns chaotic.

entries.label: wind.prevailing_strength
entries.description: Baseline prevailing wind strength (higher = more consistent trade winds and westerlies). Keep the sum with pressure_strength near 1.0.

entries.label: wind.pressure_strength
entries.description: Local pressure perturbation strength (higher = storms pull wind harder). Raise it if storms do not visibly move wind.

entries.label: evaporation.ocean_evap_rate
entries.description: Moisture an ocean cell generates per week at maximum temperature. Raise it if coasts get too little rain; lower it if the world is too wet.

entries.label: evaporation.ground_evap_rate
entries.description: Ground water evaporated per week (much slower than oceans). Lower it if droughts never form; raise it if inland dries out too fast after rain.

entries.label: transport.moisture_transport_rate
entries.description: Fraction of moisture blown downwind per week at full wind speed. Raise it if moisture does not reach inland; lower it if everywhere is equally wet.

entries.label: transport.heat_transport_rate
entries.description: Fraction of heat blown downwind per week at full wind speed; below the moisture rate because heat diffuses slower.

entries.label: orographic.cooling_rate
entries.description: Air cools by this much per unit of elevation gain.

entries.label: orographic.condensation_temp
entries.description: Below this temperature moisture condenses to rain or snow. Adjust if rain triggers too early or late relative to cold air; it sets the seasonal-storm pattern together with the baseline table.

entries.label: orographic.precip_rate
entries.description: Fraction of moisture wrung out when air rises over mountains. Raise it if rain shadows are too weak; lower it if the windward side gets a deluge.

entries.label: precipitation.rain_threshold
entries.description: Moisture must exceed this before rain can fall. Raise it if it rains too often; lower it if droughts are too common.

entries.label: precipitation.snow_threshold
entries.description: Below this temperature precipitation falls as snow. Must not exceed snow.melt_threshold. Higher moves the snow line to more regions.

entries.label: precipitation.precip_rate
entries.description: Fraction of excess moisture converted to rain per week. Raise it if moisture lingers; lower it if rain dumps too fast.

entries.label: snow.melt_threshold
entries.description: Snow melts when temperature rises above this. Must be at least precipitation.snow_threshold. Raise it if snow melts too early in spring.

entries.label: snow.melt_rate
entries.description: Fraction of the snow pack that melts per week above the melt threshold. Raise it if spring floods feel too gradual; lower it if they are too sudden.

entries.label: snow.melt_cooling
entries.description: Melting snow cools the air by this much per unit melted (latent heat).

entries.label: init.initial_moisture_water
entries.description: Week-0 moisture of water-source cells. An A4 extension; Feature 6 regression tests may tune it.

entries.label: init.initial_moisture_land
entries.description: Week-0 moisture of land cells. An A4 extension; Feature 6 regression tests may tune it.

entries.label: boundary.edge_inflow
entries.description: Whether moisture and heat flow in from outside the map edge. An A4 extension.

entries.label: influence.max_strength
entries.description: Cap on one influence strength (GDD 10a).

entries.label: influence.max_delta_pressure
entries.description: Cap on the summed pressure change per cell per week from overlapping influences (GDD 10a).

entries.label: influence.max_delta_moisture
entries.description: Cap on the summed moisture change per cell per week from overlapping influences (GDD 10a).

entries.label: influence.max_delta_temperature
entries.description: Cap on the summed temperature change per cell per week from overlapping influences (GDD 10a).

entries.label: influence.max_lifetime_weeks
entries.description: Longest one influence can last, in weeks (one season) (GDD 10a).

entries.label: influence.max_active
entries.description: Hard cap on live influences; extra requests are rejected with a reason (GDD 10a).

entries.label: influence.preview_fade_days
entries.description: Preview overlay fade-in in days (visual only) (GDD 10a).

entries.label: influence.pressure_anomaly_decay
entries.description: Share of the pressure anomaly kept each week (0.7 is about a 2-week half-life). Used by Feature 2 whether or not Feature 7 is built (GDD 10a).

entries.label: influence.pressure_anomaly_max
entries.description: Clamp on the pressure anomaly, plus or minus. Used by Feature 2 whether or not Feature 7 is built (GDD 10a).

entries.label: influence.cap_water
entries.description: Cap on the signed water weight an influence adds (Cluiche addition, provisional, Feature 7).

entries.label: influence.max_radius
entries.description: Largest influence radius in cells (Cluiche addition, provisional, Feature 7).

entries.label: influence.max_set_cells
entries.description: Largest cell-set influence in cells (Cluiche addition, provisional, Feature 7).

entries.label: influence.ground_water_factor
entries.description: Share of a WETTER/DRIER influence that reaches A5 as ground water (Cluiche addition, provisional, Feature 7).

entries.label: Baseline spring
entries.description: Normalised mean air temperature per biome in [0, 1], used as the week-0 baseline when no biome provider (A1) is present. Anchors: snow_threshold 0.3, melt_threshold 0.35, condensation_temp 0.4. The biomes.json climate centres (Grassland 0.6, TemperateForest 0.5, Desert 0.8, Tundra 0.12, Rainforest 0.85) set the annual mean; the seasonal swing is about 0.17 for continental land, 0.06 for rainforest (steady warmth) and 0.14 for water. Temperate forest winters sit at the snow line; tundra and alpine stay below it except in summer; desert and desertified plain run hot; scrub and burned ashland are warmer than the grassland they replace (dry, dark ground); wetland and lakes sit between land and ocean. This is the spring column.
